en: Black-and-white view of a broad, sunlit European boulevard lined with tall 19th‑century stone apartment buildings with arcades and awnings at street level. The square is busy with pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages and an early tramway whose tracks curve through the open space. Multi‑story façades with ornate balconies and cornices frame the scene on both sides, and the vista continues into a narrower street in the distance. The image is bordered by a white margin, suggesting a printed postcard or photographic card.
